std::forward_list

Defined in header <forward_list>. A singly linked sequence container with forward-only traversal.

Self-authored rendering fixture, not a downloaded or exhaustive cppreference page.

Synopsis

#include <forward_list>

std::forward_list<int> values{1, 2, 3};
auto before = values.before_begin();
values.insert_after(before, 42);  // insert at the front

Description

Unlike std::vector, the container does not provide random-access indexing. Use an iterator identifying the element before an insertion or erasure.

  • Forward traversal through the sequence.
  • Insertion and erasure after a valid iterator.

Member functions

OperationPurpose
before_begin()Position preceding the first element.
insert_after(pos, value)Insert a value after a valid position.
erase_after(pos)Remove the element following a valid position.
